grammar.label: existential 'there' with a complex complement
grammar.form: There + be + noun phrase + relative clause / participle / to-infinitive / prepositional phrase
grammar.meaning: introduces something new and then describes it in the same breath

explanation.en: 'There remains a question that nobody has asked.' The whole weight sits after 'there is', where English wants new information. The verb need not be 'be': 'there remains', 'there exists', 'there arose', 'there follows' all work in formal prose. The complement can be long, which is the point — 'there' holds the subject slot so it can be.
explanation.uz: 'There remains a question that nobody has asked.' Butun og'irlik 'there is' dan keyin joylashadi. Fe'l 'be' bo'lishi shart emas: 'there remains', 'there exists', 'there arose'.

grammar.positive_example: There followed a silence that neither of them was willing to break.
grammar.negative_example: A silence followed that neither of them was willing to break it.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida 'bor' bilan beriladi va ega o'rnini to'ldiruvchi so'z kerak emas; 'there' ni tushirib qoldirish odatiy xato.

grammar.label: quantifier scope and floating quantifiers
grammar.form: all / both / each moved away from the noun they quantify
grammar.meaning: changes which reading of an ambiguous quantified sentence is meant

explanation.en: 'All the members have not paid' and 'not all the members have paid' mean different things — the first says none paid, the second says some did not. Quantifiers can also float away from their noun: 'The members have all paid.' Where the quantifier sits decides what is being quantified, which is why legal drafting is so careful about it.
explanation.uz: 'All the members have not paid' va 'not all the members have paid' — turli ma'no. Miqdor so'zi qayerda turgani nimani qamrab olishini hal qiladi.

grammar.positive_example: Not all of the districts reported, and the three that did reported late.
grammar.negative_example: All of the districts did not report, and three reported late.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida inkor fe'lga qo'shiladi va miqdor so'zi o'rnida qoladi, shuning uchun ingliz tilidagi noaniqlik sezilmaydi.
